channel.title: Remarkable Places to Eat
channel.desc: Fred Sirieix is heading to Bristol for a winter treat in the company of old friend and former boss Michel Roux Jr. Bristol is home to one of the UK's most vibrant and creative food scenes, and Michel can't wait to show Fred his favourites. First is little french, a neighbourhood restaurant run by Bristol-born chef Freddy Bird.
